quiz.question: What is Seahaven Island really?
quiz.explanation: Seahaven is inside an enormous Los Angeles soundstage, allowing the producers to control Truman’s surroundings.

quiz.question: Who controls the show built around Truman’s life?
quiz.explanation: Christof is the show’s creator and executive producer.
evidence_markers: Christof, the show's creator and executive producer

quiz.question: How does the show make Truman afraid to leave by sea?
options: It stages his father’s death in a boating accident
It tells him the harbor is polluted
It sends him a fake weather report
It removes every boat from town
quiz.explanation: Christof stages the apparent death of Truman’s father in a boating accident to make Truman fear the sea.
evidence_markers: "death" of Truman's father in a boating accident

quiz.question: Why does Truman dream of traveling to Fiji?
options: His father leaves him a map
He is told Sylvia has moved there
quiz.explanation: Truman hopes to find Sylvia, whom he was told had moved to Fiji.

quiz.question: Which group does Sylvia join outside the show?
quiz.explanation: Sylvia joins Free Truman, which campaigns for his liberation from the show.

quiz.question: What unusual radio broadcast helps Truman suspect he is being watched?
quiz.explanation: Truman hears a radio transmission describing his movements around town.

quiz.question: How does Truman disappear from his home before his final escape?
quiz.explanation: Marlon discovers that Truman has disappeared through a makeshift tunnel from the basement.

quiz.question: What does Christof create to try to stop Truman’s boat?
quiz.explanation: Christof creates a violent storm to try to capsize the boat, despite objections from his colleagues.

quiz.question: What does Truman’s boat strike at the edge of his world?
quiz.explanation: The boat strikes the wall of the soundstage; Truman then discovers a staircase and exit door.
evidence_markers: boat strikes the wall of the soundstage
staircase leading to an exit door

quiz.question: How does Truman respond to Christof’s plea that he stay?
options: He asks for a new life in Seahaven
He demands a share of the profits
He says his catchphrase, bows and exits
He turns off the cameras himself
quiz.explanation: Truman delivers his familiar greeting, bows to the audience and leaves through the exit.
evidence_markers: before bowing to the audience and exiting

facts.title: Before there was Seahaven
facts.text: Andrew Niccol’s original draft was closer to a science-fiction thriller, with the story set in New York City.
evidence_markers: story set in New York City

facts.title: Waiting for the right Truman
facts.text: Jim Carrey’s commitments to The Cable Guy and Liar Liar delayed his availability. Weir chose to wait rather than cast someone else.
evidence_markers: commitments with The Cable Guy and Liar Liar
Weir felt Carrey was perfect for the role

facts.title: A real town behind the perfect suburb
facts.text: Weir’s wife Wendy Stites introduced him to Seaside, Florida. The planned community became the location for most of the filming.
evidence_markers: Wendy Stites introduced him to Seaside

facts.title: A world drawn from postcards
facts.text: Norman Rockwell paintings and 1960s postcards inspired the film’s design. The team also researched surveillance techniques for certain shots.

facts.title: The composer at the piano
facts.text: Philip Glass contributed music to the soundtrack and appears in the film playing his piece Truman Sleeps.
evidence_markers: Some parts of the soundtrack were composed by Philip Glass
Philip Glass also appears in the film playing his composition
